VIRGINIA
Fairfax County
Population1,167,873 (2025 est.)
County SeatFairfax
Land Area391 sq mi
Density2,987 / sq mi
Median Household Income$150,113
Median Home Value$699,700
Fairfax County is the largest jurisdiction in Virginia and the core of the Northern Virginia office and technology market, with Tysons, Reston and the Dulles corridor carrying high-rise office and mixed-use density around Metro's Silver Line and a tenant base of federal agencies, defense and IT contractors and firms such as Capital One headquartered in Tysons. Note that the county seat, the City of Fairfax, is an independent city outside county jurisdiction, and that development is shaped less by land supply than by entitlement, proffers, transit-oriented comprehensive plan amendments and the county's ongoing push to convert obsolete suburban office to residential.
Source: U.S. Census Bureau · Data verified: November 8, 2026
